title: penaea ruscifolia
intro: Penaea ruscifolia, commonly known as the "South African Stinkwood", is a plant species belonging to the family Rutaceae, native to the Western Cape province of South Africa. The plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. Penaea ruscifolia is said to exhibit therapeutic actions such as analgesia, antiulcerogenic, and antispasmodic effects, attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include limonoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. These bioactive compounds are believed to contribute to the plant's potential therapeutic applications in treating conditions such as pain, inflammation, and gastrointestinal disorders.
